code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(13.5, 10.5))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 2, height_ratios=[1.0, 1.0, 1.25], hspace=0.55, wspace=0.25)

# ---------- Panel A: chromosome IX locus map ----------
axA = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
axA.set_xlim(33650, 34760); axA.set_ylim(-1.2, 1.6)
axA.add_patch(mpatches.FancyArrow(34686, 0.45, -(34686-34087), 0, width=0.34, head_width=0.34,
              head_length=0, length_includes_head=True, color='#4C78A8'))
axA.add_patch(mpatches.FancyArrow(34077, 0.45, -(34077-33718), 0, width=0.34, head_width=0.34,
              head_length=0, length_includes_head=True, color='#72B7B2'))
axA.text(34386, 0.95, 'YIL164C / NIT1  (600 nt, 199 aa)', ha='center', fontsize=10, color='#4C78A8')
axA.text(33897, 0.95, 'YIL165C  (360 nt, 119 aa)', ha='center', fontsize=10, color='#72B7B2')
axA.plot([34088, 34088], [0.05, -0.55], color='#D62728', lw=1.4)
axA.text(34088, -0.75, 'in-frame TAG at codon 200\nchrIX 34,089-34,087 (Crick)', ha='center', va='top',
         fontsize=9.5, color='#D62728')
axA.annotate('', xy=(34077, 0.05), xytext=(34087, 0.05))
axA.text(34082, 0.2, '9 nt', ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#555555')
axA.text(34386, -0.3, 'both ORFs in the same reading frame (offset 609 nt = 203 codons)',
         ha='center', fontsize=9, color='#333333')
axA.set_xlabel('S. cerevisiae S288C chromosome IX coordinate')
axA.set_yticks([]); axA.set_title('A. The S288C NIT1 locus is one reading frame split by a single stop codon', loc='left', fontsize=11)
for sp in ['top','right','left']: axA.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# ---------- Panel B: protein tiling and catalytic triad ----------
axB = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
axB.set_xlim(0, 335); axB.set_ylim(-0.2, 3.1)
axB.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((1, 2.1), 322, 0.55, color='#B0B8C4'))
axB.text(162, 2.82, 'full-length ORF in RM11-1a, EC1118, YJM789, S. mikatae, S. kudriavzevii, S. uvarum (322 aa)',
         ha='center', fontsize=9.5)
axB.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((1, 1.1), 199, 0.55, color='#4C78A8'))
axB.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((204, 1.1), 119, 0.55, color='#72B7B2'))
axB.text(100, 0.78, 'YIL164C 1-199', ha='center', fontsize=9, color='#4C78A8')
axB.text(263, 0.78, 'YIL165C 204-322', ha='center', fontsize=9, color='#72B7B2')
axB.text(201.5, 0.78, 'W200 + 3 codons lost', ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#D62728')
axB.plot([200, 200], [1.05, 1.72], color='#D62728', lw=1.6)
for pos, lab in [(44, 'Glu44'), (135, 'Lys135'), (169, 'Cys169')]:
    axB.plot([pos, pos], [2.05, 2.72], color='#54278F', lw=1.2)
    axB.plot(pos, 2.78, marker='v', color='#54278F', ms=6)
    axB.text(pos, 2.95, lab, ha='center', fontsize=8.5, color='#54278F')
axB.text(330, 1.37, 'S288C', ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9)
axB.set_yticks([]); axB.set_xlabel('residue in the reconstructed full-length protein')
axB.set_title('B. Glu-Lys-Cys catalytic triad lies entirely within the YIL164C fragment', loc='left', fontsize=11)
for sp in ['top','right','left']: axB.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# ---------- Panel C: strain alleles ----------
axC = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
groups = {
 'TGG (Trp200)\nsingle 322-aa ORF': ['CLIB215','EC1118','T7','YJM269','YJM789','ZTW1'],
 'reads through codon 200\n(ORF annotated from Met120)': ['JAY291','VIN13','BC187'],
 'TAG (stop200)\nsplit into two ORFs': ['S288C','BY4741','BY4742','W303','CEN.PK','FY1679','X2180-1A',
                                        'YPH499','SEY6210','Kyokai7','UC5','K11','RedStar','g833-1B','YS9'],
}
cols = ['#59A14F', '#8CB369', '#D62728']
ys = list(range(len(groups)))[::-1]
for y, (k, v), c in zip(ys, groups.items(), cols):
    axC.barh(y, len(v), color=c, height=0.55)
    axC.text(len(v)+0.3, y, str(len(v)), va='center', fontsize=10)
axC.set_yticks(ys); axC.set_yticklabels(list(groups.keys()), fontsize=8.5)
axC.set_xlabel('number of S. cerevisiae strains (SGD panel)')
axC.set_xlim(0, 18)
axC.set_title('C. Codon 200 allele across strains', loc='left', fontsize=11)
for sp in ['top','right']: axC.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

# ---------- Panel D: ortholog lengths ----------
axD = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
orth = [('S. cerevisiae S288C\nYIL164C + YIL165C', 199, 119),
        ('S. cerevisiae RM11-1a\nB3LU11', 322, 0),
        ('S. mikatae\nA0AA35J187', 322, 0),
        ('S. kudriavzevii\nA0AA35JKD9', 322, 0),
        ('S. uvarum\nA0ABN8X0M3', 322, 0),
        ('S. pastorianus\nA0A6C1DSS1', 322, 0)]
y = np.arange(len(orth))[::-1]
axD.barh(y, [o[1] for o in orth], color=['#4C78A8']+['#59A14F']*5, height=0.6)
axD.barh(y, [o[2] for o in orth], left=[o[1] for o in orth], color='#72B7B2', height=0.6)
for yy, o in zip(y, orth):
    axD.text(o[1]+o[2]+6, yy, f"{o[1]+o[2]} aa", va='center', fontsize=9)
axD.set_yticks(y); axD.set_yticklabels([o[0] for o in orth], fontsize=8.5)
axD.set_xlim(0, 420); axD.set_xlabel('protein length (aa)')
axD.set_title('D. Orthologs are single 322-aa proteins', loc='left', fontsize=11)
for sp in ['top','right']: axD.spines[sp].set_visible(False)

plt.show()
